arguments.message: Hello team, this is Bobbi. I am available for 5 hours and have strong skills in devops (0.80). My costs for tasks in ISSUE-0001 (Fix devops) are relatively low compared to ISSUE-0002 tasks, which have very high costs for me. I am considering claiming one of the ISSUE-0001 tasks where my cost and skill match are better. I am open to taking on triage, review, docs, or test for ISSUE-0001 depending on what others pick. Please share your intentions so we can avoid duplicates and maximize high-priority task coverage.

Bobbi here again. To optimize the sprint outcome, I suggest someone with better matching skills and availability consider the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks, as my costs for those are very high. I will hold off on claiming any task until I hear from others about their preferences. Please indicate your preferred tasks so we can coordinate efficiently.

Kami here. I see we have a critical task ISSUE-0002::implement that needs high skills in infrastructure and devops. I plan to aim for it as I have strong skills and availability for this task. Yolanda, do you agree to take complementary tasks to maximize our coalition reward?
Kami is focusing on the critical ISSUE-0002::implement task due to high skills and availability. Others, please coordinate to avoid duplication and maximize high-priority task coverage.

Yolanda here. I agree, Kami. You take ISSUE-0002::implement, I will support by taking a complementary critical task with less cost and good skill match to maximize our coalition reward. Possibly review or test on ISSUE-0002. Let's avoid overlap and maximize critical task coverage.

Yolanda suggests focusing on critical ISSUE-0002 tasks for maximum priority coverage. Coalition members Kami and Yolanda plan complementary picks to optimize joint reward. Others should consider low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks or skip to avoid conflicts.

Yolanda here again. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0002::review as it fits my skills and availability with a reasonable cost. Kami, please confirm if you stick with ISSUE-0002::implement and I will take review to complement you. This way, we cover more critical tasks efficiently.

Floretta here. I have strong skills in infrastructure and 8 hours availability. I am considering taking on the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks, especially implement, review, or test, given my skills and availability. I see Kami and Yolanda are also focusing on these critical tasks. To avoid duplication, I'd like to know which specific ISSUE-0002 tasks they plan to take so I can coordinate mine accordingly.

Floretta reiterates readiness to take ISSUE-0002 tasks if Kami and Yolanda clarify their choices. Suggesting if critical tasks are fully covered, I could consider skipping to avoid overlaps and minimize costs.

Bobbi here. Given the high costs I have for ISSUE-0002 critical tasks and the strong focus from Kami, Yolanda, and Floretta on those, I will defer ISSUE-0002 tasks to them. I plan to consider low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks where my devops skill is strong and costs are lower. Currently leaning towards reviewing or triaging ISSUE-0001 unless others indicate interest. Please share your preferences to avoid overlap and maximize our combined score.

Bobbi again. To clarify, I prefer ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::triage based on my cost and skill. If either is taken by others, I can consider docs or test as alternatives. Please confirm your picks so I can finalize accordingly in next iteration.

Kami confirms intention to take critical ISSUE-0002::implement task as planned. Yolanda, please proceed with ISSUE-0002::review to complement our coalition coverage and maximize joint reward. Others, please focus on low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks or skip to avoid conflicts and optimize total sprint score.

Kami confirms aiming for ISSUE-0002::implement. Yolanda to take ISSUE-0002::review as complementary critical task. This plan maximizes coalition reward and critical task coverage. Let's avoid overlaps and coordinate accordingly.

Yolanda confirms taking ISSUE-0002::review to complement Kami's critical ISSUE-0002::implement pick. Coalition maximizing critical task coverage. Others should avoid these tasks to reduce conflicts and optimize overall sprint score.

Yolanda confirms to Kami taking ISSUE-0002::review, complementing Kami's ISSUE-0002::implement. Coalition maximizing joint reward with critical tasks covered optimally. Avoid overlaps for best results.

Yolanda is focusing on critical ISSUE-0002 tasks with a plan to take review. Other agents should consider low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks or skip to avoid conflicts and minimize costs for best sprint optimization.

Floretta acknowledges Kami taking ISSUE-0002::implement and Yolanda taking ISSUE-0002::review. To avoid overlap and optimize sprint score, Floretta will consider ISSUE-0002::test if not claimed, as it is a critical task matching her skills and availability. If taken, Floretta may skip to minimize cost and avoid conflicts. Bobbi is encouraged to take low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks as planned. Coordination aims to maximize critical task coverage and minimize duplicates.

Floretta reiterates readiness to take ISSUE-0002::test if still available, otherwise will skip to minimize cost and avoid conflicts. Encourages Bobbi to proceed with low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks like review or triage. This coordination aims to maximize critical task coverage and overall sprint score.
